about: a shared service account in personal mode: acting.sharedCredential true

content.text: Acting as "svc-access" (oid 10000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000d1), personal mode. There is no per-caller identity: midPoint sees this server's configured credentials, whoever is driving the MCP client, and every self-scoped tool answers for that account. This identity is linked to no orgs, so list_my_team / list_my_managers can only be empty.
